chapter_title: 第48章 苦等投喂的學姐

segments.title: 第48章 苦等投喂的學姐
segments.content:
When the bell rang for the end of the second evening self-study session, the movie "Snowpiercer" playing in the classroom was also reaching its end.

Li Luo was a day student and didn't board at the school, so he only needed to attend two evening self-study sessions.

After packing his schoolbag, he glanced at the corridor outside the classroom. Seeing that Ying Chanxi hadn't arrived yet, he wasn't in a hurry to leave.

"Are you a boarder?" Li Luo looked at Yan Zhusheng. Seeing that she had no intention of packing her bag, he couldn't help but ask curiously.

In his impression, Yan Zhusheng's family was not short of money. It should have been easy for her to rent a place nearby.

"I'm a boarder," Yan Zhusheng said with a serious face, a hint of anticipation in her eyes. "My home is quite far from the school, so I decided to board."

Li Luo noticed the anticipation in her eyes and reasonably suspected that Yan Zhusheng had never boarded before, which was why she was a little excited about living in a dorm.

In fact, if his family hadn't bought him an apartment, Li Luo would have preferred to live at the school.

Although the dorm conditions were just average, living with classmates was still a lot of fun.

As Li Luo was thinking this, the day students in the class had already begun leaving the classroom one after another.

A short while later, a graceful figure appeared at the back door of Class Eight.

Ying Chanxi stood in the corridor, a little embarrassed, peeking into the classroom.

She didn't know where Li Luo was sitting yet, so she didn't spot him at a glance.

Zhang Guohuang, who was near the door, turned his head and saw Ying Chanxi. He was momentarily stunned, then quickly reacted, patting his deskmate Zhu Yufei on the shoulder. "Hey, isn't that Ying Chanxi? She really came looking for him."

"Huh?" Zhu Yufei turned his head to look, then immediately shouted toward Li Luo, "Class President! Your cousin is here for you!"

At these words, the classroom, which had been a bit noisy after class, instantly fell silent.

The students in the class all looked toward the back door with curiosity and saw Ying Chanxi's pretty face.

And at the door, Ying Chanxi was also a bit dazed, not comprehending what was happening.

It wasn't until Li Luo walked out with his schoolbag and waved at her that she belatedly followed.

While walking downstairs, Ying Chanxi asked suspiciously, "What cousin? When did I become your cousin?"

"That guy in my class was probably just talking nonsense," Li Luo said, playing dumb and moving past the topic.

Ying Chanxi didn't overthink it. Instead, most of her attention was on Li Luo's deskmate.

On the way home, Ying Chanxi asked probingly, "That girl who's the sports representative in your class, she's very pretty, isn't she?"

"You mean that girl?"

"You don't think I'd call that guy pretty, do you?" Ying Chanxi said, narrowing her eyes. "She seems to be your deskmate?"

"It's just temporary," Li Luo said with a wave of his hand. "Our teacher hasn't assigned seats yet. It'll probably be changed after the military training ends."

"I don't care about that. I'm just curious how she ended up sitting next to you."

"She's quite tall, so she chose the empty seat in the last row." As Li Luo said this, he touched his face. "But if you think it was my charm that drew her to sit next to me, I think there's some truth to that."

"You're quite conceited," Ying Chanxi pouted upon hearing this. "She's so good-looking, why would she specifically choose to sit next to you."

"Why not?" Li Luo was not convinced by this statement. "During the meeting tonight, a very pretty girl asked me to sit next to her. I wonder if you remember?"

"Get lost!" Ying Chanxi's face flushed red at his words. She raised her hand as if to hit him, but then remembered they hadn't left the school grounds yet and were surrounded by students heading home. She resentfully lowered her hand and just muttered, "Shameless."

At night, the school's lights weren't very bright, and not many people on the path noticed Li Luo and Ying Chanxi.

After leaving the school gate, the two of them turned right, crossed the intersection, and walked into the entrance of the Bihai Lanting residential complex.

Walking home together after school like this was something Ying Chanxi had thought would end after the middle school entrance exams. She never expected that she would still be walking home from school with Li Luo now.

Inside the elevator, Ying Chanxi turned to look at Li Luo's side profile and then said, "Military training starts tomorrow. I bought you a bottle of sunscreen. You should take it with you."

"Huh?" Li Luo was stunned for a moment. "What do I need that stuff for? Guys aren't afraid of the sun."

"It's for sun protection, not makeup," Ying Chanxi instructed. "There's no harm in putting some on."

Just as she finished speaking, the elevator doors opened.

Ying Chanxi took out her keys and was the first to walk out and open the door.

Li Luo followed behind her without refusing again, entering through the door of 1502.

The moment he stepped inside, he saw Xu Youyu lying on the sofa, staring eagerly at the door.

"Senior Sister, what are you doing?" Li Luo was startled by her stare, wondering if his web novel author identity had been exposed or something.

But Xu Youyu just looked at him forlornly and then said, "I want to eat fried rice."

Li Luo: "..."

"You didn't have dinner, did you?"

"To be precise," Xu Youyu collapsed onto the sofa, rubbing her empty stomach, "I didn't have lunch either."

After Ying Chanxi told her through the door this morning that she was going to school to register, Xu Youyu had slept until one or two in the afternoon.

After waking up, she wrote for a while, and before she knew it, it was already evening. She had forgotten to eat lunch.

Her stomach was growling by then, so Xu Youyu planned to eat something. She subconsciously went to the kitchen, only to remember that Li Luo wasn't here today and there was no one to cook for her.

The thought of having to go downstairs to eat again, and the food at the restaurants not being as good as Li Luo's, made Xu Youyu lose her appetite.

Then she thought, since it was already five or six o'clock and the day students like Li Luo would be getting out at eight-thirty, she might as well wait a little longer.

So Xu Youyu returned to her desk.

But she was too hungry to write, so she decided to read a novel instead. Getting engrossed would make her forget her hunger.

She kept reading until just past eight. Xu Youyu glanced at the time and saw it was almost when school let out, so she eagerly went to the living room to wait.

What followed was a long wait of over twenty minutes. Now, she had finally awaited Li Luo's return.

"Senior Sister, you should at least adjust your routine," Li Luo said with a speechless expression as he changed into his slippers and headed to the kitchen. "School is about to start, you can't just keep sleeping in every day, can you?"

"My biological clock will reset automatically once school starts, I don't need to adjust it myself," Xu Youyu moaned, lying on the sofa. "Hurry up, Junior Brother, I'm about to die."

"Right away." Li Luo shook his head with a laugh, then looked at Ying Chanxi. "What about you? Want some?"

"Um... maybe just a small bowl?" Ying Chanxi thought for a moment, also craving Li Luo's fried rice. "But not too much, I've already had dinner."

"Alright, just wait."

"I'll go take a shower first."

Ying Chanxi went to shower, Li Luo made fried rice in the kitchen, and Xu Youyu waited on the sofa to be fed.

More than half an hour later.

Full and satisfied, Xu Youyu lay back on the sofa, contentedly rubbing her stomach and letting out a burp.

"I'm doomed, you've completely spoiled my taste buds. What am I going to do for the next few days while you guys are at military training?"
